resourceProfile.assessment: A fresh independent machine pass checked the complete effective locale and the surrounding runtime presentation paths after the prior convergence run.

automatedQuality.summary: Translation metadata, type checking, tests, and the complete production build passed for the resolved locale-owned batch.

linguisticCritique.summary: The convergence pass found five locale-owned defects and twenty application-wide source i18n gaps.

competentHumanReview.summary: No competent Latin American Spanish human review was performed.

publicationAuthorization.summary: No publication or deployment was requested.

findings.summary: The object-versus-material section had been mislabeled as phase changes.
evidence: The following section already owns the phase-change heading.

findings.summary: Residual concept prose used hardware, an imprecise gauge instruction, and unnecessary sólo accents.
evidence: Affected Joule hardware wording, wire-gauge system instruction/description, and saved-data confirmation.
findings.resolution: Used componentes, Indica el sistema, and contemporary solo orthography.

findings.summary: Route metadata used Conversor while the calculator and home label used Convertidor.
evidence: The effective calculator title is Convertidor.
findings.resolution: Standardized the es-419 route title on Convertidor.

findings.summary: Shared footer, home out-of-scope links, catalog-manager help, and encyclopedia date formatting bypass the message/locale APIs.
evidence: Covers original findings R4-006, R4-007, R4-008, and R4-018.
findings.ownerQuestion: Should a separate application-wide i18n migration add shared semantic IDs and locale-aware routing/date formatting for every enabled locale?

findings.summary: Battery, material, and mod validation, persistence, repository, and blocked-delete messages are hard-coded English.
evidence: Covers original findings R4-009, R4-010, and R4-011 and requires typed IDs across all enabled locales.
findings.ownerQuestion: Should the shared message API be expanded for all catalog editor/domain errors in a dedicated multi-locale change?

findings.summary: Battery Drain, Coil, Converter, TCR, Wire Wizard, and shared parallel-resistance paths expose hard-coded English errors or reference labels.
evidence: Covers original findings R4-012 through R4-017.
findings.ownerQuestion: Should a dedicated application-wide calculator-domain i18n change introduce typed error/result IDs and update every locale?

findings.summary: Material, battery, and mod entity-record prose, image text, enum labels, and some overview fields remain canonical English.
evidence: Covers original findings R4-019 through R4-022 and R4-024.
findings.ownerQuestion: Should locale-owned entity-record presentation dictionaries and typed enum/image labels be designed for every locale?

findings.summary: The material TFR graph and encyclopedia numeric values bypass localized labels or Intl.NumberFormat.
evidence: Covers original findings R4-023 and R4-025.
findings.ownerQuestion: Should graph labels and encyclopedia numeric presentation be centralized through locale-aware formatters for all enabled locales?
